description: Get the full spec sheet for one slot: provider, grid, paylines or ways, mechanic, volatility, max win, features, themes, bonus buy, minimum bet, release date, whether a free demo is available, the other games in its series and, where Reelagio has one, a short write-up of how it plays. Accepts a slot id, URL slug or name; a partial name or a small typo still resolves, and the result then says which slot was picked and what else it could have meant.

slot.description: Slot id, slug or name, e.g. "gates-of-olympus" or "Gates of Olympus"

name: get_slot
title: Get slot details
